design: build_test.py cross-LAB with LE_A=0x4444 @ X4Y4N0 + LE_B=0xAAAA @ X4Y21N0 + DFF + CLK=E1
verdict: P2 canon_2input absolute table built by build_canon_2input_codec_table.py is NOT portable across design contexts.  ~50% of absolute cells overlap with cells the codec already emits via IOB_PAD_NV / IOB_CLK_INPUT / ROUTE / OUTROUTE / LAB_CLK_SEL_LE directives.  When canon_2input_aware applies the full absolute in cross-LAB, the overlap cells double-flip and cancel, leaving LE_A's canonicalization 50% broken.  Wire2 mining does NOT isolate true canon: wire2 and wire4 absolutes intersect at ~220 cells per label.  True canon-unique cells (after subtracting all probe-directive emissions) are 123/248 (100 hdr + 19 lab_cram + 4 block_band) — and ZERO of the 19 lab_cram canon-unique cells live at LE_A's own LAB column (X=4 / col_idx=1).  Conclusion: canon_2input mining captured Quartus's full design context (IOB+routing) and mislabeled it as canonicalization.  Re-mining strategy needed: subtract codec-elsewhere emissions during mining, OR mine in a minimal IOB-free design context (Quartus-internal-LE only).
recommended_next_steps: 1. Refactor build_canon_2input_codec_table.py to compute canon_unique = abs[L] - (union of codec-other-directive emissions for the wire4 design).  This requires a codec simulation step before mining.

2. Re-flash single-LE canon_naandb_X4Y4N0 via codec with canon_unique[L] (instead of full canon_abs[L]) to validate byte-identity still holds — if Quartus's emission == codec.IOB_PAD_NV + canon_unique[L], single-LE byte-identity test confirms the split is correct.
3. Then retry cross-LAB build with canon_unique[L]; analytical mismatch should drop from 124/248 to near-zero before flashing.

context_invariance_check.method: For 9 wire2-cached labels (36 pairs), compute pair-delta in both contexts: Δ_w4[L1,L2] = Quartus_wire4(L1) XOR Quartus_wire4(L2); Δ_w2[L1,L2] = Quartus_wire2(L1) XOR Quartus_wire2(L2). If canon_unique[L] is design-invariant, the pair-deltas should match exactly (the design-context offset is the SAME for L1 and L2 so it cancels in the XOR).
context_invariance_check.result: 0/36 pairs match exactly. 32 cells diverge in wire4-only union (24 hdr + 8 lab_cram); 36 cells diverge in wire2-only union (28 hdr + 8 lab_cram).
context_invariance_check.interpretation: canon_unique IS mostly context-invariant but not exactly — Quartus emits ~30 cells per pair that depend on the wire2-vs-wire4 design context. Likely IOB-routing optimizer decisions whose CRAM footprint varies per LUT mask. Quantitative bound for cross-LAB: expect ~20-30 residual mismatches with canon_unique applied (vs the absolute-table baseline's 124/248). Success threshold for the next-session cross-LAB analytical gate: ≤30 mismatches all in IOB/CLK regions = candidate flash; >50 = model still has gaps.
context_invariance_check.open_question: What drives the 24-28 hdr cells of context-specific divergence per pair? IOB router decisions, perhaps. Mitigation strategy if cross-LAB mismatch is >30: (a) mine canon_unique in MULTIPLE design contexts (wire2, wire4, cross-LAB) and intersect; (b) accept design-context-specific canon tables per usage class.

label_invariant_baggage_audit.method: Intersection of all 24 canon_unique[L] cell sets at X4Y4N0
label_invariant_baggage_audit.finding: canon_unique[L] retains 138 cells of label-invariant wire4 design-context baggage (almost entirely in hdr region — IOB infrastructure for E15+M15 routing that the codec did not subtract because the single_le_cells IOB_ROUTE bucket is quarantined). Only ~37.5 cells/label are label-specific. When canon_unique[L] is applied in a design that does NOT use E15+M15 pins (e.g. cross-LAB build_test uses E16+M16+G15+E1), those 138 hdr cells inject wire4-specific IOB infra into the wrong design context — the same class of bug the previous session found with the absolute table, just shifted to a different cell set.
label_invariant_baggage_audit.cross_lab_expected_mismatch_revised: Likely ~138 hdr mismatches when canon_unique[L] applied in cross-LAB design — the analytical mismatch may stay near 124/248 or even grow. The lab_cram improvement (~115→~25) is real but the dominant residual is hdr.
label_invariant_baggage_audit.next_refinement_path: Subtract a wire4-context IOB baseline before per-label diffing. Candidate baselines: (a) canon_const0_X4Y4N0 (mask=0x0000, Quartus wire4 build with LUT-bypass — already cached from Phase 4 P4 audit `canon_cells_X4Y4N0_constants.json`); (b) canon_const1 (0xFFFF) same; (c) explicitly mine an `IOB_PAD_NV_WIRE4` directive that extends IOB_PAD_NV to all 4 wire4 pins, then subtract that. The (a)/(b) path is the cheapest: load canon_const0_X4Y4N0.rbf, compute wire4_baseline_delta = canon_const0_rbf XOR codec_emit(0x0000), then refined_canon_unique[L] = canon_unique[L] XOR wire4_baseline_delta.
